data.body: Task 172 follow-up 2026-10-04: plugins now live in ONE Settings section, "Tool Plugins" (id tool_plugins) - folder listing (Refresh/Open folder/Install/Add/Use updated/Remove) plus the complete added-plugin config, including the MCP command/args/cwd/credentials and functions, reusing McpServersSection with allowAdd/allowRemove false. The MCP servers tab shows general servers only (entries without a plugin pin). Both share the stored mcpServers array but are separate dirty/rebase domains in settingsDraft.ts, and an mcpServers validation issue maps to tool_plugins when it has a plugin. The ComfyUI manifest no longer passes --api-key-env/COMFYUI_API_KEY in args (it tripped the inline-secret check twice); bridge.py defaults COMFYUI_API_KEY and the user binds a credential in env. Verified: tsc clean, vitest 81/81, Rust tool_registry 10/10. Old installs must re-run Install plugin… from the updated folder then Use updated plugin.
